op.description: Create a new generation task. Supply the complete prompt in text, output kind in mediaKind, and only that kind’s parameter fields. Shots use confirmed assets and existing production outputs. Ordinary research materials are allowed for standalone draft experiments and standalone asset-generation tasks; shot tasks require confirmed assets or shot outputs. Omitted settings inherit the referenced task or selected model settings.

mediaModelId.description: Media model ID from mstudio_models. Omit to use the user's selected model. If this turn already has a selected model, an explicit ID must match it; this field cannot override that choice.

text.description: Complete final prompt sent to the generation model. For request_generation this field is text, not prompt or shot.prompt. The host does not append the shot draft or script automatically.

id.description: Existing target shot ID. Omission inherits the referenced task’s shot when present; otherwise creates an exploratory task on the draft canvas. For a reusable standalone image use generationPurpose=asset, which forbids id.

canvasTaskKey.description: Exact canvas task key referenced by this turn; omit when targeting only a shot. Not a shot ID or a new arbitrary task name.

mediaKind.description: Generate a still image. This branch has no mode or duration.

aspectRatio.description: Use the selected model's aspectRatio enum from mstudio_models.

resolution.description: Use the selected model's case-sensitive resolution enum from mstudio_models.

options.description: Per-task generation options. Use only keys and values declared by the selected model in mstudio_models.parameters.options.

purpose.description: What to preserve or use from this asset, e.g. product geometry, top view or character identity. Put descriptive text here, never in role.

role.description: Image input mode: reference = visual guidance; edit = source image to modify. Omission defaults to reference. Describe identity, geometry, viewpoint or composition in purpose.

start.description: Reference video trim start in seconds; only meaningful for video-reference. Not output clip duration.

end.description: Reference video trim end in seconds, greater than start and within the source video duration.

mode.description: Video input arrangement: single = first-frame image; ends = first-frame and last-frame images; multi = reference images; mixed = image/video references. Omission inherits the referenced task arrangement; without a source task it defaults to single. When supplying reference images explicitly, also set mode=multi.
